qualification.details: Qualification: Deputation: officers under Central or State Governments, Union territories, Universities, recognized research institutions or statutory and autonomous organizations holding analogous posts on regular basis, or with three years' regular service in PB-4 (Rs. 37400-67000) with Grade Pay Rs. 8700 or equivalent; Master's degree in Fine Arts or History of Art from a recognized University; Contract: persons possessing the educational qualifications and experience specified in item I(b)(i) and (ii) Experience: 15 years' experience including research work in one or more of the fields of Fine Art or History of Art, out of which five years' experience should be in administrative matters Age limit: Maximum 67 years (as on the closing date for receipt of applications) | Other conditions: | Deputation candidates must hold analogous posts on regular basis, or have three years' regular service in PB-4 with Grade Pay Rs. 8700 or equivalent Departmental Director in PB-4 Grade Pay Rs. 8700 with three years' regular service and the prescribed qualifications will be considered along with outsiders | Desirable: | Ph. D. in Fine Arts or History of Arts Proven record of Publication or Exhibition participations and Fellowships

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay Matrix Level 14, Rs. 144200-218200 (7th CPC); pre-revised PB-4 Rs. 37400-67000 plus Grade Pay Rs. 10000

how_to_apply: Fill the application in duplicate in the prescribed proforma (Annexure) enclosed with the circular.
Officers attach complete up-to-date CR dossiers for the last five years, vigilance certificate, integrity certificate, cadre clearance and major/minor penalty statement for the last 10 years.
Attach supporting certificates/documents for qualifications and experience claimed.
Send the application through proper channel to the Under Secretary, Museum-I Section, Ministry of Culture, Kartavya Bhawan 2, New Delhi.
Application must reach within 45 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News.
Make sure it reaches by 20 December 2026.
important_instructions: Applications received after the due date or incomplete will not be considered and stand rejected Applications/CV without supporting certificates for qualifications and experience will not be processed for eligibility Employer/Cadre Controlling Authority must certify the application and confirm the officer will be relieved immediately if selected

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Deputation: officers under Central or State Governments, Union territories, Universities, recognized research institutions or statutory and autonomous organizations holding analogous posts on regular basis, or with three years' regular service in PB-4 (Rs. 37400-67000) with Grade Pay Rs. 8700 or equivalent; Master's degree in Fine Arts or History of Art from a recognized University; Contract: persons possessing the educational qualifications and experience specified in item I(b)(i) and (ii) Experience: 15 years' experience including research work in one or more of the fields of Fine Art or History of Art, out of which five years' experience should be in administrative matters Age limit: Maximum 67 years (as on the closing date for receipt of applications) Other conditions: Deputation candidates must hold analogous posts on regular basis, or have three years' regular service in PB-4 with Grade Pay Rs. 8700 or equivalent Departmental Director in PB-4 Grade Pay Rs. 8700 with three years' regular service and the prescribed qualifications will be considered along with outsiders Desirable: Ph. D. in Fine Arts or History of Arts Proven record of Publication or Exhibition participations and Fellowships

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Ministry of Culture Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: A person who has married a person having a spouse living, or who, having a spouse living, has married any person (Central Government may exempt)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract appointment for three years, may be extended subject to age limit of seventy years and satisfactory performance Contract terms and conditions as applicable to a Group A officer of the Central Government holding analogous post If departmental candidate is selected, the post is treated as filled by promotion

content_sections.heading: How Will Ministry of Culture Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection through a high-level Search-cum-Selection Committee comprising experts in the field Search-cum-Selection Committee: Cabinet Secretary (Chairman), Principal Secretary to the Prime Minister, Secretary DoPT, Secretary (Culture) as Members Three experts in Museum or Gallery Management, Modern and Contemporary Art and Fine Art, nominated by the Prime Minister from five recommended by the Minister of Culture Committee may adopt a flexible procedure to seek out and consider persons of outstanding ability

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in duplicate in the prescribed proforma (Annexure) Complete up-to-date CR dossiers for the last five years, or ACR photocopies attested by an Under Secretary or above Vigilance certificate and integrity certificate Cadre clearance Major/minor penalty statement for the last 10 years Supporting certificates/documents for qualifications and experience claimed

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after the due date or incomplete will not be considered and stand rejected Applications/CV without supporting certificates for qualifications and experience will not be processed for eligibility Employer/Cadre Controlling Authority must certify the application and confirm the officer will be relieved immediately if selected

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Ministry of Culture Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Ministry of Culture Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Director General.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Ministry of Culture Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure: Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae proforma enclosed with the vacancy circular) and send it to Under Secretary to Govt. of India, Ministry of Culture, Museum-I Section, Work Hall - 22108, Kartavya Bhawan 2, New Delhi -110001, by through proper channel, to reach by 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 67 years (as on the closing date for receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Matrix Level 14, Rs. 144200-218200 (7th CPC); pre-revised PB-4 Rs. 37400-67000 plus Grade Pay Rs. 10000.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree in Fine Arts or History of Art from a recognized University and 15 years' experience including research work in Fine Art or History of Art, of which five years in administrative matters; deputation candidates must also hold analogous posts or have three years' regular service in PB-4 with Grade Pay Rs. 8700 or equivalent.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Deputation candidates must hold analogous posts on regular basis, or have three years' regular service in PB-4 with Grade Pay Rs. 8700 or equivalent. Departmental Director in PB-4 Grade Pay Rs. 8700 with three years' regular service and the prescribed qualifications will be considered along with outsiders.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A person who has married a person having a spouse living, or who, having a spouse living, has married any person (Central Government may exempt).

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection through a high-level Search-cum-Selection Committee comprising experts in the field. Search-cum-Selection Committee: Cabinet Secretary (Chairman), Principal Secretary to the Prime Minister, Secretary DoPT, Secretary (Culture) as Members. Three experts in Museum or Gallery Management, Modern and Contemporary Art and Fine Art, nominated by the Prime Minister from five recommended by the Minister of Culture. Committee may adopt a flexible procedure to seek out and consider persons of outstanding ability.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contract appointment for three years, may be extended subject to age limit of seventy years and satisfactory performance. Contract terms and conditions as applicable to a Group A officer of the Central Government holding analogous post. If departmental candidate is selected, the post is treated as filled by promotion.
